1. Select your car's Bluetooth device.

2. Grant the requested permissions to the app.

3. It is very important to allow location access using the "Allow all the time" option.

4. Once configured, the app will wait for your car's Bluetooth to disconnect.

5. When the Bluetooth connection is lost, the app will save your current location as your parking location.

6. You can then tap the saved location or the notification to open the map and see where your car is parked.

To automatically save your parking location when you leave the app or turn off the screen, Leo\'s BTPark needs to access your location in the background. You cannot continue until you have granted the app "Allow all the time" location access.

On the next screen:
1. Tap "Permissions".
2. Select "Location".
3. Select "Allow all the time".

This screen will remain open until you grant the required permission. Once the permission has been correctly granted, Leo's BTPark will automatically return to the main screen.

You can choose whether the status notification can be dismissed or stays available at all times. If you dismiss it, you can still access the app by opening it from your device. If you choose to keep it always visible, the notification will be automatically recreated whenever it is dismissed.
